comparison.objective: Rotate and extract a T-head bracket from a keyed housing; candidate adjusts and retains a damper setting.
comparison.physical_skill: Bimanual counterholding, roughly 80-degree rotation, and linear extraction versus hex-key unlocking, separate fine collar rotation, socket reacquisition, and torque-limited locking.
comparison.success_condition: Two components held apart over outlines versus repeated safe carriage dynamics plus verified lock retention.
comparison.reason: Both involve counterholding and rotation, but the bracket task tests keyed disengagement/extraction, not calibrated tuning or retained adjustment. Record has no specs or force/damage thresholds.
